128Propose h5Global boundary-conductance fault: model overestimates the ihs→ambient boundary conductance by ~7% (real chip hotter). Explains uniform-map residuals (~6.7% of rise at nominal/75%/50% within power-draw tolerance), near-zero single-block own-site residuals (lateral shunting hides a boundary fault), and both transients being ~8-15% slower (tau scales with R). Commit #1 failed likely due to SIGN convention (reported -0.07 instead of model-relative +0.07) and/or missing core2 row.
129Propose h6core2 power_gain fault: real dissipated power at core2 ~5% above card value 0.9905 (nominal c2 excess fraction 5.2±0.8% over baseline sensors; m6/m19/m20 single-block excesses 6-7% within draw noise). Model-relative error ~ -0.05.

Model uses constant factory conductance and under-predicts temperature by ~0.0021*theta^2 (near 0 at low power, +3.5C at nominal, +4.3C at 110%). Evidence: steady residual fraction of rise grows with level (mapA 4.5%, 50% 3.4%, mapB 4.0%, 75% 6.5%, nominal 8.2%, 110% 9.1%) — residual ~ theta^2, excluding any constant conductance/power factor (constant f needs per-level power draws from -3.6% to +2%, monotone in level, mapA outside +-4% spec; theta^2 law needs only +-1% draws). Transient m28: pkg excess ~0 at 0.12s growing to +3.4 late (constant factor would show +0.4 already at 0.12s); m45 50% transient tau near factory. Single-block max maps m7-m13 clean (theta^2 residual ~0.1-0.6 at small theta). No c2 model fault: c2 excess over the global law (+0.3..+1.3C, i.e. 2-3% of rise) is within the 3% sensor slope-error spec at all levels; no block-local fault found on any block.
